reviewer: Codex assistant with local image vision
scope: Actual source/target images visually inspected alongside operation payloads: random 20 train, 7 known validation cases, all 45 additional cases touched by initial simplification. Focused edit review, not full background reannotation; no new human confirmation.

cases.instruction: Add a pizza cutter.
cases.observation: Visible cutter added at left edge, on wooden support. Cropping/metal/handle are optional for the plain addition.

cases.instruction: let the monitor show a star field wallpaper
cases.observation: Dark foreground monitor becomes blue star graphic. Preserve content change, not merely generic blue.

cases.instruction: Add a bright sun
cases.observation: Bright sun and extra blue/yellow kite both appear; keep incidental kite structural operations and requested brightness.

cases.instruction: Replace the chips with fries.
cases.observation: Chips become fries; identity replacement is visible. Keep original observed appearance for this non-addition request.

cases.instruction: Remove the person.
cases.observation: Person and held phone disappear. Both node deletions and incident edge deletions supported.

cases.instruction: change the skateboard into a stilt
cases.observation: No recognizable stilt appears. Only cropped footwear changes; requested transformation is not represented by observed label. Quarantine train, do not invent stilt.

cases.instruction: let the man be bald
cases.observation: Hair becomes bald; preserve explicit property edit.

cases.instruction: Add a third kite.
cases.observation: Additional kite visible upper right. Count wording is relative and source has other distant kites; keep original graph multiplicity and appearance.

cases.instruction: Have there be a clock on the wall
cases.observation: Clock appears over lower beam region. Keep original observed beam deletion/occlusion; extra appearance is optional for clock.

cases.instruction: Let the grass be taller.
cases.observation: Foreground grass becomes taller/denser; preserve height and density.

cases.instruction: let the bears sit on a leather couch
cases.observation: Fabric sofa becomes leather-looking upholstery. Preserve material and observed color change.

cases.instruction: turn the cat into a hedgehog
cases.observation: Cat becomes a hedgehog-like rendered animal; artificial shape, label plausible but not a strong natural-photo category example.

cases.instruction: add a phone
cases.observation: Phone clearly added beside pizza on counter; screen color is unspecified.

cases.instruction: Make the hair of the person getting a tie put on blonde.

cases.instruction: Add a lizard.

cases.instruction: remove the advertisement
cases.observation: Text overlay removed. Label says text overlay; request calls it advertisement. Preserve observed deletion.
